description: This file defines the MetaController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace, responsible for handling API requests related to metadata such as module lists, field lists, and Swagger schemas. It uses the MetaService to obtain data and extends a base controller for response formatting.

classes.name: MetaController
classes.description: A controller class that manages API endpoints for retrieving metadata information such as module lists, field lists, and Swagger schemas. It depends on MetaService for data retrieval and inherits response handling functionalities from BaseController.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Handles requests to fetch a list of modules via the MetaService and returns a formatted JSON response.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Handles requests to fetch a list of fields for a given module, using specified parameters, via the MetaService, and returns a response.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Returns the Swagger schema for the API by invoking the MetaService, formatted as a JSON response.
